_note: Curated/fixed. All hits below are the MOUNTED (on Skaarl) forms of Kled's kit, KledQAbility/KledWAbility/KledEAbility/KledRAbility -- the default and by far the more common state. Dismounted-form spells (KledRiderQAbility etc, used only after Skaarl dies) are structurally separate BIN spell objects with their own DataValues and are NOT modeled (no live signal for mount state) -- left uncurated, a real known gap for the minority dismounted-Kled case.
_noteQ: Q (Bear Trap on a Rope, KledQAbility) ADDED a second hit -- was only modeling the initial throw. TotalDamage = FirstHitBaseDamage + 0.6 bonusAD, physical (first hit, matches prior auto-pick). TotalYankDamage = TotalDamage x2 (GameCalculationModified, real BIN multiplier) -- Kled's real Q also lets him recast within TetherPopTime to yank the tethered target for a SECOND, larger hit ('Pop the tether'); curated as a second, separate hit representing a full throw+yank usage (a realistic completed-Q assumption, matching this project's general convention of modeling the successful/completed cast).
_noteW: W (Violent Tendencies, KledWAbility) FIXED a real bug and added: the calc 'PercentDamage' (0.01x(4HitMaxHealthDamage[4-7] + 0.02 bonusAD-coeff + 0.004 bonusHP-coeff), mDisplayAsPercent) is a %MAX-HP FRACTION, not flat damage -- treating it as a literal flat number (as the prior curation's structure would if calc'd directly) would be wrong by roughly 2 orders of magnitude; correctly wired via hpPercentCalc/hpBasis Max. The real mechanic only triggers this bonus every 4th consecutive attack against the same target (a toggle-style ability) -- curated as a single direct hit on W's own cast node (one 4th-hit proc), a documented conservative collapse rather than auto-firing on every AA (which would overcount by ~4x). A separate flat BaseFlatDamage on-hit term exists in the DataValues but has no exposed GameCalculation referencing it in this BIN dump -- not fabricated, left out.
_noteR: R (Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, KledRAbility) FIXED a real bug: MaximumChargeDamage is ALSO a %MAX-HP fraction (0.03x(PercentHPBase[2-14] + 0.03 bonusAD-coeff), mDisplayAsPercent) that the prior curation used as flat literal damage -- same class of bug as W, now fixed via hpPercentCalc/hpBasis Max. Uses the FULLY-CHARGED (3s charge-up, SecondsToMaxPower) value rather than the lesser MinimumDamageTooltip floor, matching this project's convention of modeling an intentional/well-executed cast (an engaging Kled player charges before impact).
